record.context_brief: Global rigidity of irreducible higher-rank Anosov actions
record.original_question: Is every irreducible Anosov action of Z^k or R^k, with k ≥ 2, C^∞-conjugate to an algebraic action?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 4. Every “irreducible” Anosov Zk - and Rk -action, k ≥ 2, is C ∞ -con-jugate to an algebraic action.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k \geq 2$ and let $G$ be either $\mathbb{Z}^k$ or $\mathbb{R}^k$. A smooth action $\alpha : G \times M \to M$ on a closed smooth manifold $M$ is called Anosov if there exists an element $g_0 \in G$ such that the diffeomorphism $\alpha(g_0, \cdot)$ is Anosov (i.e., the tangent bundle $TM$ admits a continuous $D\alpha(g_0,\cdot)$-invariant splitting $TM = E^s \oplus E^u$ on which $D\alpha(g_0,\cdot)$ is uniformly contracting and expanding, respectively). 

An algebraic action is one of the following: $M = K \backslash H / \Gamma$ where $H$ is a connected Lie group, $\Gamma \subset H$ is a cocompact lattice, $K$ is a compact subgroup of $H$ commuting with the action, and $G$ acts via a homomorphism into $H$ acting by left translations; or more generally an action on an infranilmanifold by affine automorphisms.

The action $\alpha$ is called irreducible if it does not have non-trivial rank-one factors (equivalently, no finite cover of the action splits as a product in which one factor is an action of a rank-one subgroup of $G$), and every finite-index subaction is topologically transitive.

Question: Is every irreducible Anosov action of $\mathbb{Z}^k$ or $\mathbb{R}^k$ with $k \geq 2$ on a closed manifold $C^\infty$-conjugate to an algebraic action?
artifact.category_tag: Higher-rank Anosov actions and global rigidity
artifact.status_search_result: This is the Katok–Spatzier global rigidity conjecture. It remains open in full generality, but substantial partial results are known: Kalinin–Spatzier and Kalinin–Sadovskaya proved versions under conformality/algebraic assumptions on coarse Lyapunov foliations, and Rodriguez Hertz–Wang established strong global rigidity for higher-rank Anosov $\mathbb{Z}^k$-actions on tori/nilmanifolds assuming only one Anosov element with suitable linearization. A general proof for arbitrary closed manifolds is not available.

status_evidence.title: Global rigidity of higher rank abelian Anosov algebraic actions
status_evidence.snippet: Rodriguez Hertz and Wang prove global rigidity for higher-rank Anosov Z^k-actions on tori and nilmanifolds, requiring only one Anosov element with linearization satisfying certain conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Partial resolution of the Katok-Spatzier conjecture for tori/nilmanifolds.

status_evidence.title: An Invitation to Rigidity Theory — R. J. Spatzier
status_evidence.snippet: Significant progress on the Katok-Spatzier conjecture has been achieved during the last decade, though the general conjecture remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture is partially solved; general case open.

status_evidence.title: The Katok-Spatzier Conjecture and Generalized Symmetries
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses the Katok–Spatzier global rigidity conjecture for higher-rank abelian Anosov actions.
status_evidence.claim: Active research topic, not fully resolved.
